reference: Noted in E. González-Jiménez, F. Najman, An algorithm for determining torsion growth of elliptic curves, Exp. Math. 32 (2023), 70-81, arXiv:1904.07071; identified as isolated by A. Bourdon, D. R. Gill, J. Rouse, L. D. Watson, Odd degree isolated points on X_1(N) with rational j-invariant, arXiv:2006.14966 (2020), Theorem 2 and Section 4.7.
notes: The rational elliptic curve 338.e2 (j = 351/4 = 3^3 * 13 / 2^2) acquires a point of order 28 over this degree-9 field. Bourdon-Gill-Rouse-Watson show that the point is isolated (dim L(D) = 1 over F_11, rank J_1(28)(Q) = 0), and that -140625/8 and 351/4 are the only non-CM rational j-invariants of isolated points of odd degree on the curves X_1(N).
